Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

zugrpc 0.0.0.9000

  • grpc_channel() opens a channel to a gRPC server over cleartext HTTP/2 (http://) or TLS (https://). It can build on a zuhttp::zu_client() you supply, so proxies, TLS settings and test transports carry over. grpc_close() closes it.
  • grpc_call() makes a unary call. It returns the response message with its initial and trailing metadata, and raises zugrpc_error_status, with a class per status code, when the call fails. Responses that are not gRPC or break its framing raise zugrpc_error_protocol.
  • A failed call’s condition carries details, the google.rpc.Status decoded from the grpc-status-details-bin trailer, with each error detail such as ErrorInfo unpacked. A trailer that does not decode is a zugrpc_warning_details warning, and the status is kept.
  • grpc_stream() makes a server-streaming call. Its $next_message() returns one message at a time as it arrives, so the server sends only as fast as you read. $cancel() stops the call and keeps the connection. grpc_close() cancels a channel’s open streams, and a stream that is no longer referenced is cancelled when it is garbage-collected.
  • A call whose deadline has already passed fails with DEADLINE_EXCEEDED without being sent.
  • grpc_keepalive() sets HTTP/2 keepalive for a channel. By default a connection idle for 60 seconds is checked with a PING before its next call, as Spark Connect’s Python client does.
  • Each call no longer spends about a millisecond rebuilding the user-agent string.
  • zugrpc_info() reports the zuhttp version, whether it speaks HTTP/2, and its TLS backend.
  • Failures below gRPC raise zugrpc_error_transport, which is also zugrpc_error_unavailable. A timeout is DEADLINE_EXCEEDED, and an interrupt raises zugrpc_error_interrupt.
  • grpc_status_codes() lists the 17 gRPC status codes.
  • The gRPC wire format, internal for now: message framing, metadata with -bin values in base64, the grpc-timeout header, grpc-status and grpc-message decoding, and the HTTP-status fallback.

Developed by Pedro Baltazar.
